verdict.rationale: Docusaurus has built-in, well-documented versioning support (versioning CLI to snapshot docs directory into a version, version dropdown for readers to switch) and dedicated docs on this exact workflow, plus i18n for localization. No independent hands-on corroboration specifically for the versioning UX is present, and no evidence of a version-switcher dropdown being explicitly named, so missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of the version-switch UI in practice, edge-case coverage for large numbers of versions.
